import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    dim_hist = inputs["DIM_EMP_HIST"].copy()
    asof_q = inputs["ASOF_QUERIES"].copy()

    # Normalize types to ensure correct comparisons regardless of how the
    # input DataFrames were constructed (e.g. object dtype dates, nullable
    # ints, etc.)
    dim_hist["emp_id"] = dim_hist["emp_id"].astype("Int64")
    dim_hist["eff_start_date"] = pd.to_datetime(dim_hist["eff_start_date"])
    dim_hist["eff_end_date"] = pd.to_datetime(dim_hist["eff_end_date"])

    asof_q = asof_q.copy()
    asof_q["query_id"] = asof_q["query_id"].astype("Int64")
    asof_q["emp_id"] = asof_q["emp_id"].astype("Int64")
    asof_q["as_of_date"] = pd.to_datetime(asof_q["as_of_date"])

    # Inner join on emp_id first (cartesian over matching emp_id), then
    # apply the half-open interval predicate.
    merged = asof_q.merge(
        dim_hist,
        on="emp_id",
        how="inner",
        suffixes=("", "_hist"),
    )

    start_ok = merged["as_of_date"] >= merged["eff_start_date"]
    end_ok = merged["eff_end_date"].isna() | (
        merged["as_of_date"] < merged["eff_end_date"]
    )

    filtered = merged[start_ok & end_ok]

    result = filtered[["query_id", "emp_id", "dept", "grade"]].reset_index(
        drop=True
    )

    return {"asof_result": result}
